title: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing
description:
arXiv:2609.21096v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this work, we examine the topology of information flow patterns within attention graphs to effectively distinguish hallucinated from non-hallucinated responses. We analyze the Forman-Ricci curvature to identify structural patterns indicating information bottlenecks in attention graphs. We then introduce a method that captures both semi-local and global information-flow characteristics of attention heads associated with hallucinated responses. W
